title: Flow Matching from Viewpoint of Proximal Operators
abstract: arXiv:2602.12683v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We discuss the dynamics of Optimal Transport Conditional Flow Matching (OT-CFM) under the manifold hypothesis, where the support of the target distribution is a low dimensional manifold. We first derive an exact proximal expression of the vector field, using an extended Brenier potential for the OT; the vector field can be expressed by a denoiser, which is presented as the proximal operator associated with the potential function. Based on this explicit proximal form of the vector field, we analyze the manifold stability for perturbations to initial points, using the Lyapunov exponents of the dynamics. By analyzing the local behavior with the tools in convex analysis, we show that the dynamics contract linearly in the perturbation of the normal directions to the manifold, while perturbations in the tangential directions are preserved; this implies the stability of the manifold structure to the perturbations. translated_title: 从近端算子视角看流匹配
translated_abstract: 我们讨论了流形假设下最优传输条件流匹配（OT-CFM）的动力学，其中目标分布的支撑集是一个低维流形。我们首先利用扩展的Brenier势导出了向量场的精确近端表达式；该向量场可由一个去噪器表示，而该去噪器可呈现为与势函数相关联的近端算子。基于向量场的这一显式近端形式，我们利用动力学的Lyapunov指数分析了初始点扰动下的流形稳定性。借助凸分析工具对局部行为进行分析，我们证明动力学在流形法向方向上的扰动呈线性收缩，而切向方向上的扰动则得以保留；这表明流形结构对扰动具有稳定性。为了支持该理论……
tldr: 该论文通过扩展Brenier势将最优传输条件流匹配（OT-CFM）的向量场精确表示为与势函数相关的近端算子（去噪器），并借助Lyapunov指数证明其流形稳定性：法向扰动线性收缩而切向扰动被保留。
en_tdlr: This paper derives an exact proximal-operator (denoiser) expression for the OT-CFM vector field via an extended Brenier potential and proves manifold stability using Lyapunov exponents: perturbations in normal directions contract linearly while tangential perturbations are preserved.
